06 / BEFORE WE TALK

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Something else on your mind?
Email Nabura Labs directly ↗

Who is this a good fit for?+

Software companies with an existing product and engineering team, particularly those using React, Next.js, TypeScript, or GraphQL. Engagements are most effective when there is a defined architecture, modernization, or delivery challenge, with an accountable owner and budget.

Do we need a diagnostic before implementation?+

No. When the problem and acceptance criteria are already clear, we can scope an improvement sprint directly. A diagnostic is useful when your team needs evidence and a plan before deciding what to build.

Will you write code or only advise?+

Both, depending on the engagement. The diagnostic produces findings and a roadmap, not production changes. Improvement sprints include the agreed implementation. Fractional support can include code within the monthly allowance.

How do you handle access, IP, and AI tools?+

Access and ownership are agreed in writing before work begins. Access is limited to what the engagement requires, and tools are approved by the client. Confidential code or data is not entered into AI tools without authorization. A confidentiality agreement can be discussed before sensitive materials are shared.

Who does the work? Do you subcontract it?+

The founder is your primary consultant and delivers the agreed work. Any additional specialist involvement would be discussed and approved before anyone else joins the engagement.

Can you work remotely with our team?+

Yes. Engagements are designed for remote collaboration. Working overlap, meetings, response expectations, and availability are agreed during scoping. Continuous availability and unlimited support are not included.

What happens if the scope changes?+

Changes are reviewed before additional work begins. We agree on revised deliverables, pricing, and timing in writing so that the impact is clear to everyone.
